# Ledgerly 5.0.0 Release Notes

Brightwater Software, Inc.

Release date: Monday, September 29, 2026

Ledgerly 5.0.0 is now available. You can update from the app store.

## 1 New features

This release adds the following two features:

1. Fixed monthly costs can be entered automatically on a day you choose.
2. One household budget can be shared across family members' devices.

## 2 Fixed issues

This release fixes the following two issues:

1. Spending that crosses a month boundary was added to the previous month's total.
2. Amounts entered in a foreign currency were not converted to dollars.
3. The chart legend could run off the edge of the screen.

## 4 Support

End of support for 5.0.0: September 30, 2025

Support for 4.6.0 ends on March 31, 2027. Please update to 5.0 before then.

For questions, write to Brightwater Support (support@brightwater-soft.example).
